items.title: Joseph Rene and Edna Kelly Interview, 1969-12-15
items.q: I met him the other day. Yeah? ... He's a blind fellow. Some kind of preacher, huh? Boy, he could tell you something.

ctx.x: But, uh... That's the guy who he was. Yeah. Well, it looks like...
They had another clan player who used to play with us. I don't get no record of him. And he does play a wonderful clan in him. They call him, uh, Freddie Small. I met him the other day. Yeah?
